subject: Hotel keysafe logistics & late-night arrival plan — rooming + dietary flags
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzales <maria@acmeanalytics.com>; Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hotel keysafe logistics & late-night arrival plan — rooming + dietary flags

Hi Maria / Daniel —

Thanks for the heads-up on arrivals. We want to make the check-in flow as frictionless as possible for the two execs arriving after midnight. A couple of items we need to confirm from your side so the hotel can execute: 

- Official arrival windows and flights for the late arrivals (airline + flight # + ETA).
- Do you want rooms held under a master bill or should we set those two to direct bill to Acme? (We can split the master bill to include meeting space and the rest to Acme if that helps accounting.)
- Dietary flags for any evening snacks / next-day breakfast (allergies, vegetarian, halal, gluten-free, severe allergies).
- Preference on key handoff: the hotel offers a keysafe/lockbox option for late arrivals (they provide rotating 4-digit code and concierge handoff in the morning) or a meet-and-greet at 12:30a for an extra fee. Which do you prefer?

We have a tentative plan (details below) but will not finalize until we get the flight times and billing preference.

Tentative plan (hotel: Harborview Suites)
- Keysafe on arrival: hotel places key packets in a numbered lockbox at the rear valet; rotating code is issued to us the morning of arrival and will be shared with your travelers via encrypted SMS.
- Concierge morning check: hotel concierge will do a morning sweep at 07:30 and leave a welcome packet on the door if they used the keysafe.
- Quiet-floor requests: we'll request rooms on the executive quiet wing (levels 7–8) and put a Do Not Disturb sign for 1st night only.
- Shuttle windows: 06:45–09:15 (AM) / 17:30–20:00 (PM) — we can adjust for an earlier arrival if you tell us exact arrival times.

If keysafe is OK, we will: 1) lockbox the two rooms, 2) send a one-time code to your travelers and to the Redwood event lead (Marissa), and 3) rotate the code after all arrivals are confirmed.

Please send flight info and dietary flags when you can. If you'd rather pay for a concierge meet-and-greet, note that as well and we will book.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Program Manager, Events & Ops
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Maria Gonzales <maria@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 12:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hotel keysafe logistics & late-night arrival plan — rooming + dietary flags

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers: 

- Two late arrivals: 
  * Karen Liu (VP Product) — UA 2145, ETA 00:45 local (late red-eye from SFO).
  * Mark Patel (CRO) — DL 5499, ETA 01:10 local (connecting).
- Billing: please put everything on the master bill except rooms for Karen & Mark — charge those to Acme (we'll provide card on file). If that complicates the hotel's process, master bill is fine and we'll reconcile after.
- Dietary: Karen (vegetarian, nut allergy); Mark (no dietary restrictions). Both prefer a light breakfast — coffee + fruit to their rooms before the workshop start.
- Keysafe: keysafe + morning concierge sweep is fine. No meet-and-greet required.

One more ask: Karen prefers a quiet room with blackout curtains and a kettle in-room. Mark prefers a top-floor room if available.

Thanks,
Maria

--
Maria Gonzales
Head of Partnerships 
Acme Analytics
maria@acmeanalytics.com | +1 (646) 555-0284
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Maria Gonzales <maria@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hotel keysafe logistics & late-night arrival plan — rooming + dietary flags

Thanks Maria / Soojin —

We will execute the keysafe workflow. Notes from coordination call with Harborview F&B + front desk this morning: 

- Lockbox details: hotel will provide a photo of the lockbox and a 4-digit code. We will not post the code in email; code will be sent via Twilio SMS to the two travelers and via Redwood secure channel to Marissa. Attached: rooming_manifest.csv (contains room numbers and confirmation numbers).
- Code rotation: hotel rotates the box code nightly. For tonight, front desk will set code to 7412 at 23:00 local; we will change to 3928 after both check-ins confirmed (hotel front desk will call Marissa to confirm).
- Master bill split: Harborview can split folios. We will put meeting rooms, AV, catering on Redwood master and bill rooms for Karen + Mark to Acme's card (hotel requires card on file by 18:00 local). Maria, please confirm you will send the card details securely (we've shared the DocuSign link).
- Rooming specifics: Karen — room 808A (executive quiet wing, blackout, kettle); Mark — room 1002 (top floor, king). We requested a DND tag for first night on Karen's door.
- Breakfast delivery: F&B will do a light continental tray (coffee, fruit, granola) delivered at 07:00 to both rooms. Maria: confirmed vegetarian + nut-free for Karen.
- Shuttle: Harborview will hold the 06:45 pick-up for hotel-to-workshop run; we will notify attendees of two pick-up points (hotel lobby and 6th St ride-share bay).

Attachments: rooming_manifest.csv (CSV with traveler name / room / confirmation), hotel-keysafe-photo.jpg (photo of lockbox location).

Action items: 
- Maria: upload Acme card on DocuSign by 18:00 local (see link above).
- Soojin: please trigger the Twilio SMS once Marissa confirms both check-ins.
- Laura: please note these rooms in the morning registration print — we will not list room numbers publicly, just names.

I'll be on-site tonight to confirm the rotation and will call once both guests are checked in.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Events Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hotel keysafe logistics & late-night arrival plan — rooming + dietary flags

Got it — thanks team. I'll add the DND and breakfast flags to the registration print and hold the attendee badges at will-call so we don't disclose room numbers.
